rationale.conceptual: The method involves a custom application of non-local theory to graded materials, requiring non-trivial mathematical derivations (Fourier transforms, dual integral equations, Schmidt orthogonalization with Jacobi polynomials) that must be accurately encoded. Several interacting components and careful handling of branch cuts, infinite integrals, and series truncation make this genuinely demanding to implement correctly.
rationale.execution: The pipeline is simple: two sequential computational steps (solve coefficients, evaluate stress) using standard Python/NumPy/SciPy. No complex orchestration, external tooling, or data assembly is needed; the output is a single CSV file.

This demands a solid understanding of continuum mechanics and advanced numerical methods, translating to a high conceptual difficulty. Execution is straightforward: a single Python script with two sequential steps, no external data or heavy orchestration.
